name: Jal Jeevan Mission
full_name: Jal Jeevan Mission - Har Ghar Jal
benefit: Piped drinking water connection to every rural household, 55 litres per person per day
benefit_hindi: Har gaon ke ghar mein pipeline se saaf paani, 55 litre har vyakti ko roz

eligibility.description: All rural households without piped water connection
eligibility.description_hindi: Gaon ke woh ghar jinmein pipeline se paani nahi aata
criteria: Rural household without tap water connection
Priority: SC/ST households, quality-affected areas, drought-prone areas

steps: Contact Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office
Submit application for tap water connection
Village Water and Sanitation Committee (VWSC) will process
No charge for connection in most states
steps_hindi: Gram Panchayat ya Block Development Office se sampark karein
Tap water connection ke liye application dein
Gaon ki Jal Samiti application process karegi
Connection free mein diya jaata hai
Koi charge nahi lagta zyaadatar rajyon mein

hindi_summary: Jal Jeevan Mission mein har gaon ke ghar mein pipeline se saaf paani aayega. Gram Panchayat mein application dein — connection free hai. Helpline 1800-115-515 par call karein.
